review.why: Plans listings in startup, SaaS, AI and agent directories: readiness check, tiers, positioning variants, tracker, launch-day plan and backlink verification.
review.summary: Starts with a nine-question readiness check and rules to build destination pages first, then groups directories into thirteen tiers with a submission order. It covers a listing kit, a Product Hunt plan, a review-collection protocol, how to verify an actual backlink, KPIs and an agent workflow that stops at logins, bot checks and payments.
strengths: Safety gate: checks each target is live and asks for approval before each submission
Positioning varies by directory type instead of one pasted description
Honest on weak targets such as badge-swap indie launch sites
cautions: Many statistics and conversion figures are unsourced
Directory lists date quickly; five reference files are not read here
Outreach and review incentives need care under each site's rules
